ita: Io e mio padre manderemo\nall'aria il vostro embargo!
nld: Mijn pa en ik zijn hier om daar\neen stokje voor te steken!
tur: Babamla benim burada durdurmaya\nçalıştığımız şey de bu!

label: Player_StgWin_140
deu: Ach, sind wir schon fast da?\nGut zu wissen. Los, Papa!
eng: So what you're saying is, we're\nalmost there? Let's go, Dad!
esp: ¡Ah! ¿Entonces ya casi\nestamos? ¡Vamos, papá!
fra: On va se gêner ! Surtout qu'ils\ndoivent plus être bien loin !
ita: Quindi questo significa... Papà,\nl'Imperatore è vicino!
nld: Bedoel je dat we er bijna zijn?\nVooruit dan, papa!

label: Player_StgWin_141
deu: Dass ihr die Kontrolle über Sushi\nhabt, ist sicher kein guter Plan!
eng: I won't accept a world where\nyou guys control the sushi!
esp: Sí que la hay: ¡un mundo sin\nvuestro monopolio del sushi!
fra: « Cause » toujours ! Tout le\nmonde a droit aux sushis !
ita: Non accetterò un mondo in cui\nqualcuno controlla tutto il sushi!
nld: Ik ben fel tegen een wereld\nwaarin jullie de sushi bezitten!
tur: Suşiyi sizin kontrol ettiğiniz bir\ndünyayı kabul etmiyorum!

label: Player_StgWin_142
deu: Och, tröste dich damit, wie viele\nich schon allein erledigt habe!
eng: Sorry, I don't have time for your\nwhining! Gotta catch up to Dad!
esp: No tengo tiempo para tus lamentos,\n¡debo alcanzar a mi padre!
fra: Va pleurnicher ailleurs, il faut\nque je rattrape papa !
ita: Scusa, non ho tempo per le tue\nciance. Devo raggiungere papà!
nld: Sorry, ik heb geen tijd voor je\ngemekker! Ik ga met papa mee!
tur: Üzgünüm, mızmızlanmanı dinleyecek\nvaktim yok! Babama yetişmeliyim!

label: Player_StgWin_143
deu: Wir wollen auch, dass immer\nSushi da ist – aber für alle!
eng: It's only endless for you! What\nabout the rest of the world?!
esp: Comer sin fin... ¡vosotros, claro!\nY el resto del mundo, ¿qué?
fra: À volonté pour vous ! Et le\nreste du monde, t'en fais quoi ?
ita: Il dominio a vantaggio di pochi\nè ingiusto. Il sushi è di tutti!
nld: Alleen eindeloos voor jou!\nEn de rest van de wereld dan?!
tur: Sadece senin için sonsuz! Peki ya\ndünyanın geri kalanı?!

label: Player_StgWin_144
deu: Ja, ja, daran hättest DU mich\naber hindern sollen, oder?
eng: It's time I met Octavius. We\nneed to have a talk about sushi!
esp: ¡Ha llegado la hora de que\nOctavius y yo hablemos de sushi!
fra: Oh que si ! Et je vais lui dire\ndeux mots, au passage !
ita: È ora che lo incontri. Dobbiamo\ndiscutere del sushi!
nld: Ik wil naar Octavius. Ik zal een hartig\nwoordje met hem spreken over sushi!

label: Player_StgWin_145
deu: Sushi gehört nicht einer Person!\nEs gehört allen!
eng: Sushi doesn't belong to any\none person! It's everyone's!
esp: Nadie puede controlar todo el\nsushi. ¡Es de toda la humanidad!
fra: Quand comprendras-tu que les\nsushis sont à tout le monde ?
ita: Il sushi non appartiene a una sola\npersona. È di tutto il mondo!
nld: Sushi is niet van één persoon!\nHet is van iedereen!

label: Player_StgWin_146
deu: Weil ich mir vorstelle, wie alle\nLeute es mit Freude essen...
eng: Because I picture everyone else\nin the world enjoying it, too!
esp: Porque, además de saborearlo,\n¡me imagino cómo lo saborean otros!
fra: J'imagine celui que le monde\nentier ressentira bientôt !
ita: Perché so che presto tutti lo\nmangeranno e sorrideranno!
nld: Omdat ik wil dat alle mensen ter\nwereld ervan kunnen genieten!

label: Player_StgWin_197
deu: Du musst dich beim Abluchsen\nhalt fuchsiger anstellen!
eng: It's all mine! If you want one,\nfind it yourself!
esp: Sí, claro. ¡Ven a por ella\nsi la quieres!
fra: Pas question ! Si t'en veux un,\ndébrouille-toi tout seul !
ita: Scordatelo, è mia! Se la vuoi,\ntrovatela da solo!
nld: Je krijgt hem niet! Zoek er zelf\nmaar een!

label: Player_StgWin_198
deu: In meinen Stein wird mal gar\nnichts gemeißelt, klar?
eng: Dude... You lost, and you're\nstill making terrible puns?
esp: Ya te digo, qué poca\ngenerosidad la mía, ¿verdad?
fra: Tu fais des jeux de mots nazes\nà chaque fois que tu perds ?
ita: Credi sia il caso di dire assurdità\nanche adesso che hai perso?
nld: Gast... Je hebt verloren. Hou je nooit\nop met die flauwe woordgrapjes?
tur: Dostum... Kaybettin ve hâlâ\nberbat kelime oyunları mı yapıyorsun?

label: Player_StgWin_199
deu: Ein Schrein, ja? Und da ist\ndann auch die weise Frau?
eng: A shrine, huh? Is that where the\nlane-drive gear engineer is?
esp: ¿Un templo? ¿Estará allí la\npersona que construye piñones?
fra: C'est là-bas que se trouve le\nspécialiste en régulateurs ?
ita: Un tempio, eh? L'ingegnere che fa\nle rotelle kaiten si trova lì dentro?
nld: Een tempel... Is de priesteres\ndie bandwielen maakt, daar?
tur: Bir tapınak, ha? Şerit Dişlisi\nmühendisi orada mı?

label: Player_StgWin_200
deu: Kein Geheimnis ist sicher, wenn\nArchie in der Nähe ist!
eng: Heheh! No secret is safe with\nArchie around!
esp: Je, je... Tenemos a un tal\nArchie que se entera de todo.
fra: Héhé ! Rien n'est assez bien\ncaché pour Archie !
ita: Eh eh eh... Nessun segreto è al\nsicuro con Archie nei paraggi!
nld: Hehehe! Voor Archie is geen\nenkel geheim veilig!
tur: Hehe! Archie yanındayken\nhiçbir sır güvende değil!

label: Player_StgWin_201
deu: Warum sollten sie? Hast ja\ngesehen, was sie dir bringen...
eng: Yeah! Why, are they supposed\nto be scary?
esp: Pues... no sé. ¿Deberían\ndarme miedo o algo?
fra: Ouais ! Pourquoi, t'es censé\nfaire peur ?
ita: Sì, perché? Dovrebbero\nspaventarmi, secondo te?
nld: Ja! Had ik bang voor ze moeten\nzijn, of zo?
tur: Evet! Ne yani, korkutucu mu\nolmaları gerekiyor?

label: Player_StgWin_202
deu: Aber schön warm! Eine kalte\nDusche hattest du ja gerade...
eng: You have fun! I'll just be on\nmy way...
esp: Harás bien, sí, que luego\napestas. Yo sigo mi camino.
fra: Une douche suffira pas à laver\nton honneur après cette rouste.
ita: Spero tu non voglia usare\nquel tuo sapone al wasabi...
nld: Veel plezier! Ik ga lekker\nverder...

label: Player_StgWin_203
deu: Glaub nicht alles, was man\ndir sagt!
eng: Don't believe everything\nyou hear!
esp: ¡Pues cómo serán los demás!
fra: Faut pas croire tout\nce qu'on raconte !
ita: Non credere a tutto quello\nche ti dicono!
nld: Geloof niet alles wat je hoort!

label: Player_StgWin_204
deu: So etwas Ähnliches habe ich\nschon mal irgendwo gehört...
eng: It's weird, but I feel like I've\nheard that before.
esp: Mmm... Creo que eso\nya lo he oído antes.
fra: Hum... J'ai déjà entendu ces\nsalades quelque part...
ita: Mh? Questa storia del più forte\nmi sembra di averla già sentita...
nld: Vreemd, maar dat heb ik ergens\neerder gehoord.

label: Player_StgWin_205
deu: Ja, bist du... und alle deine\nKameraden anscheinend auch.
eng: You and everyone else in his\ncommand, apparently!
esp: Me parece que os lo dice\na todos para animaros.
fra: Comme tous ceux qui sont sous\nses ordres, visiblement.
ita: Il tuo capitano lo dice a ognuno\ndi voi, se proprio lo vuoi sapere.
nld: Net als ieder ander in je\narmzalige troepje, blijkbaar!
tur: Görünüşe göre sen de\nemrindeki herkes de!

label: Player_StgWin_206
deu: Darum ging es... Na wartet, das\nRädchen hole ich mir zurück!
eng: So that was their plan! Still,\nI'm getting that gear back!
esp: Así que ese era el plan... ¡Pues\nlo voy a recuperar como sea!
fra: Il me faut ce régulateur !
ita: E così era questo il loro piano!\nRiprenderò la rotella a tutti i costi!
nld: Dat was dus hun plan! Ik moet\ndat bandwiel terugkrijgen!
tur: Demek planları buydu! Yine de,\no dişliyi geri alacağım!

label: Player_StgWin_209
deu: Ist ja nett... Aber ich überwinde\neh jedes Hindernis – mit Sushi!
eng: It doesn't matter! Sushi will\ncarry me past any obstacle!
esp: Qué majo... No sufras, que el\nsushi me protege de disgustos.
fra: Peu importe ! Le sushi me fait\nsurmonter tous les obstacles !
ita: È un bel pensiero, ma grazie al\nsushi supererò qualsiasi ostacolo!
nld: Het maakt niet uit! Met sushi\nben ik onverslaanbaar!
tur: Önemi yok! Suşi beni her engelin\nötesine taşır!

label: Player_StgWin_210
deu: Ich muss nur ein Experiment\nstoppen.
eng: There's a suspicious experiment\nhere that I'll put a stop to!
esp: Se cuecen oscuros experimentos...\n¡y los voy a detener!
fra: Non ! J'ai un projet\nmachiavélique à interrompre !
ita: Stanno facendo un esperimento\nsospetto qui. Intendo fermarlo!
nld: Er vindt hier een verdacht experiment\nplaats dat ik een halt ga toeroepen!
tur: Burada şüpheli bir deney var;\nbuna son vereceğim!

label: Player_StgWin_211
deu: Und ob ich das tue! Ihr habt da\netwas, das mir gehört.
eng: I sure am! I'm gonna get back\nwhat you stole!
esp: ¡Pues sí! ¿Cómo lo sabes?\n¡Y vais a devolver lo robado!
fra: J'y vais de ce pas ! Récupérer\nce que vous m'avez volé !
ita: L'hai detto! Sono venuto a\nriprendermi ciò che avete rubato!
nld: Zeker weten! Ik kom terughalen\nwat je gestolen hebt!

label: Player_StgWin_212
deu: Dieses Rädchen braucht ihr ja\nsicher nicht für den Fortschritt...
eng: It'll have to march on without\nthat gear, then!
esp: No tiene por qué... ¡sobre todo\nsi es la historia de un robo!
fra: Elle a qu'à apprendre à marcher\nsans ce régulateur, la science !
ita: Il vostro progresso farà a meno\ndi quella rotella!
nld: Dan moet het maar zonder dat\nbandwiel verder zien te gaan!
tur: O zaman o dişli olmadan\nyoluna devam etmek zorunda!

label: Player_StgWin_213
deu: Sushi macht mehr Mut als ein\nHauptmann, glaub mir!
eng: Don't believe that guy! Listen\nto your sushi-loving heart!
esp: Pues vaya motivación... Pero tú\ncree en el sushi; te dará fuerzas.
fra: On s'en fiche du capitaine !\nÉcoute la voix du sushi !
ita: Non credere al tuo capitano! Abbi\nfede nel tuo amore per il sushi!
nld: Geloof hem niet! Luister naar\nje liefde voor sushi!
tur: O adama inanma! Suşi seven\nkalbini dinle!

label: Player_StgWin_214
deu: Der Schwächste... Das kommt\nmir doch bekannt vor!
eng: You don't have to prove you—\nWait, this sounds familiar.
esp: Otra vez la sensación de haber\ntenido ya esta conversación...
fra: Mais non, t'es pas... Eh ! J'ai\ndéjà entendu ça quelque part !
ita: Ho la sensazione di aver già\navuto questa conversazione...
nld: Je hoeft niet te bewijzen dat je...\nWacht, dit klinkt bekend.
tur: Kendini kanıtlamak zorunda değilsin—\nDur, bu tanıdık geldi.

label: Player_StgWin_215
deu: Mach dir nichts draus. Der taugt\nja wohl als Anführer auch nicht.
eng: This guy sounds like the worst\nleader I've ever heard of!
esp: Dile a tu capitán que deje de\nleer esos libros sobre liderazgo.
fra: C'est ton capitaine, le nul ! Tu\nparles d'un meneur d'hommes !
ita: Questo capitano sembra il\npeggior leader mai esistito...
nld: Die kapitein klinkt niet bepaald\ngezellig...

label: Player_StgWin_216
deu: Ehrliche Antwort? Ach, lassen\nwir's lieber...
eng: This whole squad has been\na real downer to fight...
esp: No, es la psicología moderna,\nque ha hecho mucho daño.
fra: Ce bataillon me colle le cafard,\nje suis pas fâché d'avoir fini.
ita: Questa squadra avrebbe bisogno\ndi una visita da un terapista...
nld: Deze hele divisie is een teleurstelling\nom tegen te vechten...
tur: Bu timle kapışmak baştan sona\nmoral bozucuydu...

label: Player_StgWin_217
deu: Wofür ist die Magnetkanone?\nWas bewacht ihr hier?
eng: Why is there a Magnetic Shot\nhere?! What are you guarding?!
esp: Qué cosas haréis en ese centro,\npara tener esta tecnología...
fra: Pourquoi un canon magnétique,\nd'abord ? Vous gardez quoi ?
ita: Perché c'è un Cannone magnetico\nqui?! Cosa state sorvegliando?!
nld: Wat doet dit magneetkanon\nhier?! Verbergen jullie iets?!
tur: Burada neden Manyetik Atış var?!\nNeyi koruyorsun?!

label: Player_StgWin_218
deu: Ja, gut so! Maschinen, die\nSushi verschwenden... Pfui!
eng: That's what you get for building\nmachines that waste sushi!
esp: ¡Os lo merecéis, por construir\nmáquinas que ofenden al sushi!
fra: Voilà ce qui arrive quand\non gâche les sushis !
ita: Chi costruisce diavolerie che\nsprecano il sushi non merita altro!
nld: Dat komt ervan als je machines\nbouwt die sushi verspillen!
tur: Suşiyi boşa harcayan makineler\nyapmanın cezası bu!

label: Player_StgWin_219
deu: Wahres Glück kommt eben nie\ndurch ein falsches Sushi-Tor!
eng: True happiness could never\ncome through a fake sushi gate!
esp: ¡La felicidad nunca vendrá de\nun portal del sushi artificial!
fra: Une véritable amitié ne pouvait\npas venir d'un faux portail !
ita: Da un portale del sushi artificiale\nnon può venire la vera felicità!
nld: Met een neppe sushipoort\nbereik je nooit het ware geluk!
tur: Sahte bir suşi kapısından\ngerçek mutluluk gelmez!

label: Player_StgWin_221
deu: Nicht mehr so ganz, wie mir\nscheint...
eng: Hey, I'm not the one who\nbrought it up!
esp: Pues ya va siendo hora\nde saber algo...
fra: Comme si c'était moi qui avais\nmis le sujet sur le tapis.
ita: Ehi, non è che stai già\nspifferando un po' troppo?!
nld: Hé, ik ben niet degene die\nerover begon!

label: Player_StgWin_222
deu: Wenn ich das höre, werde ich\nerst recht neugierig!
eng: Hearing you say that just makes\nme more curious!
esp: Sí, si te creo, pero es que\nme apetece seguir por aquí.
fra: Hmm... T'en fais trop.\nC'est hautement suspect
ita: Se mi preghi di non fare una cosa\ndel genere, considerala già fatta!
nld: Dat maakt me alleen maar\nnieuwsgieriger!

label: Player_StgWin_223
deu: Ja, blöd, solange es noch kein\nShampoo mit Sushi-Duft gibt.
eng: I do feel bad about that. Maybe\ntell him I was just too good?
esp: Lo siento mucho. ¿Quieres que\nle diga que no es culpa tuya?
fra: Pas de bol pour toi ! T'as qu'à\nlui dire que je suis invincible.
ita: Dai, senza rancore! Digli che il tuo\navversario era imbattibile, magari.
nld: Nou voel ik me schuldig. Kun je hem\nzeggen dat ik gewoon te goed was?
tur: Biraz kötü hissettim doğrusu. Ona\n“Musashi fazla iyiydi” dersin belki?

label: Player_StgWin_224
deu: Aber bei mir wird Sun-o\nviel glücklicher sein!
eng: Sun-o will be happier with\nme anyway!
esp: No es cuestión de vergüenza, es\nque Sun-o estará mejor conmigo.
fra: Pas question ! Elle sera bien\nplus heureuse avec moi !
ita: Sun-o me lo prendo io, grazie.\nVedrai, sarà contento.
nld: Sun-o is bij mij toch\ngelukkiger!

label: Player_StgWin_225
deu: Oh, tut mir leid. War nicht böse\ngemeint, okay?
eng: S-sorry about that. No hard\nfeelings, OK?
esp: Jolín, lo siento... Ahora hasta\nme siento un poco mal.
fra: Désolé. Allez, je file.\nSans rancune !
ita: Oh, come mi dispiace... Ora non\npenserai che sono cattivo, spero.
nld: S-Sorry. Zand erover, goed?

label: Player_StgWin_226
deu: Ich würde mitkommen, aber ich\nmuss einen Sushi-Geist finden!
eng: I'd come with you, but I've got\na rare sushi sprite to find!
esp: Gracias por la invitación, pero\n¡tengo que encontrar a un genio!
fra: Je ferai bien un beach-volley,\nmais j'ai une sushinité à trouver.
ita: Verrei volentieri con te, ma uno spirito\ndel sushi raro mi sta aspettando!
nld: Ik zou best met je mee willen, maar ik\nmoet een zeldzame sushigami vinden!
tur: Seninle gelirdim ama bulmam\ngereken nadir bir suşi ruhu var!

label: Player_StgWin_227
deu: Dann bewachst du hier wohl\nirgendwas Dolles, was?
eng: Then that must mean there's\nsomething you were guarding!
esp: Ah... Eso significa que tenéis algo\no alguien que custodiar, ¿no?
fra: Ça, ça veut dire que je suis\nsur la bonne voie !
ita: Questo significa che sorvegliavi\nqualcosa di interessante, vero?
nld: Aha, je was dus iets aan het\nbewaken!

label: Player_StgWin_228
deu: Tja, wenn man mir meine Teller\nklaut, esse ich einfach mehr!
eng: When my plates get stolen,\nI just eat more!
esp: Es que, si me roban los platos,\n¡más motivo tengo para comer!
fra: Moi, quand on me pique mes\nassiettes, je vois rouge !
ita: Quando mi rubano i piatti, mi\nbasta mangiare più velocemente!
nld: Als mijn borden worden gestolen,\neet ik gewoon nog meer!
tur: Tabaklarım çalınırsa,\nben de daha çok yerim!

label: Player_StgWin_233
deu: Hör mal, Purrsilla ist nicht mehr\nhier. Glaub mir das!
eng: I told you—Purrsilla isn't even\nhere anymore.
esp: ¡No sufras! Ya te he dicho que\nvuestra princesa se ha largado.
fra: De toute façon, Purrsilla a\nmis les bouts.
ita: Non c'è da preoccuparsi, perché\nPurrsilla non è più qui.
nld: Ik zei toch al dat Purrsilla\nhier niet meer is!

label: Player_StgWin_234
deu: Weißt du nicht, dass ihr das\ninzwischen herzlich egal ist?
eng: Did nobody tell you Purrsilla\ndoesn't care about that now?
esp: ¿No te han dicho que lo de no\ncomer salmón ya no se lleva?
fra: T'es au courant que Purrsilla\na annulé cet ordre, au moins ?
ita: Non ti ha detto nessuno che a Purrsilla\nnon importa più questa cosa?
nld: Heeft niemand je verteld dat dat\nPurrsilla niets meer kan schelen?
tur: Kimse sana Purrsilla'nın artık\nbunu umursamadığını söylemedi mi?

label: Player_StgWin_235
deu: Wovon ist die denn wohl\nso müde...?
eng: He's so dedicated that it almost\nbrings a tear to my eye.
esp: Admiro sinceramente tu\ndedicación y compromiso.
fra: Quel dévouement ! J'en ai\nles larmes aux yeux.
ita: Che esempio di sublime devozione.\nQuasi mi viene da piangere...
nld: Hij is zo toegewijd dat ik er\ntranen van in de ogen krijg.
tur: O kadar adanmış ki neredeyse\ngözlerim doluyor.

label: Player_StgWin_236
deu: Also, genau gesagt... ja!
eng: I didn't want to be the one to\nbreak it to you, but...
esp: No quiero ser yo quien te lo\ndiga, pero... sí.
fra: Eh bien, c'est-à-dire\nqu'en fait, euh... Oui.
ita: Non volevo essere io a dirtelo,\nma... pare che sia così.
nld: Ik breng niet graag slecht\nnieuws, maar... inderdaad.
tur: Bunu sana söyleyen ben olmak\nistemezdim ama...

label: Player_StgWin_237
deu: Ja, ja, immer die anderen.
eng: They're not so hard when you\nknow how to handle 'em!
esp: No son tan duros como dicen,\nsolo hay que conocerlos un poco.
fra: Ils ont pas pu. Ils étaient trop\noccupés à ramasser leurs dents.
ita: Non sono poi tanto tosti, quando\nsai come affrontarli!
nld: Ze zijn niet lastig, als je weet\nhoe je ze aan moet pakken!
tur: Nasıl başa çıkacağını bilirsen\no kadar da zor değiller!

label: Player_StgWin_238
deu: Vorschriften vom Verlierer?\nDas geht ja wohl gar nicht!
eng: Well, I am. Try not to be a sore\nloser about it!
esp: Intento entenderlo, sí,\n¡pero de verdad que no puedo!
fra: Je vais où je veux, il va\nfalloir t'y faire.
ita: Oh... Dici sul serio? Quasi quasi...\nE invece no. Vado avanti!
nld: Mooi wel, dus. Til er niet te\nzwaar aan!

label: Player_StgWin_239
deu: Spar dir deine Tricks, da vorn\nseh ich doch einen Schrein!
eng: Nice try, but I think I see a\nshrine up ahead!
esp: No cuela... Está más adelante, así\nque ya me estás dejando pasar.
fra: Bien essayé, mais tu vas\ndevoir trouver mieux !
ita: Bel tentativo! Ma ho già visto\nun tempio qui vicino!
nld: Leuk geprobeerd, maar ik zie\ndaar verderop een tempel!
tur: İyi deneme, ama sanırım\nileride bir tapınak görüyorum!

label: Player_StgWin_240
deu: Wer rastet, der rostet...\nDa ist was dran!
eng: Guess it's true what they say:\nyou snooze, you lose!
esp: Nada, tómate tu tiempo para\ndespertar. Yo sigo, si eso.
fra: Qui fait la grasse-mat' se bat\ncomme une savate, c'est connu.
ita: Eh, sì. Hai perso! Chi dorme\nnon piglia spiriti!
nld: Als dat het beste is wat je kunt,\nkun je beter in bed blijven liggen!

label: Player_StgWin_249
deu: Hmmm... mir noch nicht.
eng: Hmmm... I don't see\nanything yet.
esp: Mmm... No, todavía no\nse ha acercado por aquí.
fra: Hum... Rien pour le moment.
ita: Mmmh... No, non ancora.
nld: Hmmm... Nog niet.

label: Player_StgWin_250
deu: Offensichtlich hat er ihn\nkomplett verpasst...
eng: It must've missed the\nwhole thing...
esp: O no sabe apreciar un gran\ncombate, o se lo ha perdido.
fra: J'imagine qu'elle a rien vu...
ita: O non ha apprezzato lo\nspettacolo o se l'è perso...
nld: Die heeft het vast gemist...

label: Player_StgWin_251
deu: Ja, du warst mit Herz bei der\nSache. Find ich gut!
eng: Believe me, I could tell you\nwere fighting your heart out!
esp: Y bien que has hecho, ¡se\nnota que le pones empeño!
fra: Merci. Tu as mis tout ton cœur\ndans ce combat, je le sais !
ita: Beh, modestamente... Ti sei\nbattuto con valore, però.
nld: Geloof me, ik kon zien dat je\nalles gaf wat je in je had!

label: Player_StgWin_252
deu: Gegen meine Leidenschaft für\nSushi kommst du halt nicht an!
eng: You can trick me, but there's no\ngetting around my sushi skills!
esp: Eso ha sonado un poco raro.\n¿O me quieres confundir?
fra: Tu peux me berner, mais tu ne\npeux rien contre ma technique !
ita: Puoi ingannarmi, ma nessuna frode può\nbattere il mio valore di guerriero sushi.
nld: Mij kun je om de tuin leiden, maar\nom mijn sushitalent kun je niet heen!

label: Player_StgWin_253
deu: Was soll ich sagen? Ich höre\neben den Ruf des Sushi-Geists.
eng: What can I say? I hear the sushi\nsprite calling, that's all!
esp: Es la llamada de lo prohibido.\n¡Y del genio del sushi!
fra: Je ne fais que suivre l'appel de\nla sushinité, c'est tout !
ita: Che dire... È il richiamo dello\nspirito del sushi!
nld: Wat zal ik zeggen?\nDe sushigami roept me!
tur: Ne diyeyim? Suşi ruhunun\nsesini duyuyorum, hepsi bu!

label: Player_StgWin_254
deu: Ist wohl nicht dein Tag heute,\nwas?
eng: Just isn't your day, huh?
esp: Reconocer el problema es el\nprimer paso para solucionarlo.
fra: C'est pas ton jour de chance,\non dirait.
ita: Sembra che oggi non sia\nproprio il tuo giorno...
nld: Je hebt zeker je dag niet?

label: Player_StgWin_255
deu: Einen sechsten Sinn? Nein,\neinfach nur ein gutes Näschen.
eng: A sixth sense is cool, but I like\nto say I have a nose for them!
esp: Lo del sexto sentido suena bien,\n¡pero basta con un buen olfato!
fra: Disons que j'ai juste du flair !
ita: Ben detto, ma più che sesto\nsenso direi fiuto.
nld: Ik heb er gewoon een neus voor, al\nzou een extra zintuig ook cool zijn!

label: Player_StgWin_256
deu: Iss Sushi, dann spürst du die\nKälte gar nicht mehr.
eng: Eat some good sushi and you\nwon't even notice the cold!
esp: ¡Come un poco de sushi\ny entrarás en calor!
fra: Mange donc des sushis, ça te\nréchauffera !
ita: Mangia del buon sushi e vedrai\nche ti passa anche il freddo!
nld: Eet wat goede sushi, dan voel\nje de kou niet!
tur: İyi bir suşi ye,\nsoğuğu fark etmezsin bile!

label: Player_StgWin_257
deu: Kein Problem mit meiner\nSushi-Geist-Spürnase!
eng: It'll be easy! I'll just follow\nmy nose for sushi sprites!
esp: No es tan difícil, ¡mi nariz me\nllevará a los genios del sushi!
fra: Ce sera facile ! Il me suffit de\nressentir les sushinités !
ita: Un tempio non si cerca con gli occhi,\nma con il fiuto per gli spiriti.
nld: Makkelijk! Ik volg gewoon mijn\nneus tot ik sushigami vind!

label: Player_StgWin_258
deu: Vielen Dank!\nDen werd ich sicher haben.
eng: I will, thanks!
esp: Ah, vale... ¡Gracias!
fra: Mais j'y compte bien !
ita: Lo farò, grazie!
nld: Oké, bedankt!

label: Player_StgWin_259
deu: Kein Wunder. Ist ja ganz schön\nabgelegen, wo du hier bist.
eng: Yeah, I could see how being\nout here will do that to you.
esp: No me extraña, en un lugar\ncomo este...
fra: Ouais, après être resté enfermé\nici, c'est pas étonnant.
ita: Non mi stupisce molto,\nconsiderando il luogo...
nld: Ja, ik kan me best voorstellen\ndat je hier uit vorm raakt.

label: Player_StgWin_260
deu: Ninja-Training...? Sagt mir\njetzt nichts.
eng: This place is so pretty, I'd want\nto lose myself here too.
esp: Bueno, no es un mal sitio\npara ese tipo de entrenamiento.
fra: C'est si joli ici, j'aimerais bien\nm'y cacher moi aussi.
ita: In effetti non è un brutto posto\nper un corso del genere.
nld: Het is hier zo mooi dat ik ook wel\nin de omgeving op zou willen gaan!
tur: Burası o kadar güzel ki,\nben de burada kaybolmak isterdim.

label: Player_StgWin_261
deu: Hör mal, dieses Ninja-Training...\nSpielt ihr hier etwa Verstecken?
eng: Wait... This "stealth training"...\nAre you playing hide-and-seek?!
esp: Vuestro entrenamiento en mi pueblo\nse llama "jugar al escondite".
fra: Votre entraînement furtif c'est...\nune partie de cache-cache ?
ita: Ehi! Ma quale camuffamento?\nState giocando a nascondino?!
nld: Wacht... Is die camouflagetraining\ngewoon verstoppertje?!

label: Player_StgWin_262
deu: Öhm, bin ich gemeint oder die\nanderen Versteckspieler...?
eng: I can't tell if he means with me\nor his hide-and-seek soldiers...
esp: ¿Me lo decías a mí, o hablas de\nvuestro juego del escondite?
fra: Tu parles de combat de sushis\nou de cache-cache ?
ita: Non ho capito se dice a me o ai\nsoldati che giocano a nascondino!
nld: Ik weet niet of hij mij bedoelt, of de\nsoldaten met wie hij verstoppertje speelt...
tur: Benimle mi yoksa saklambaç askerleriyle\nmi dediğini anlayamıyorum...

label: Player_StgWin_263
deu: Tröste dich. Zumindest MEINE\nLaune ist damit ja gerettet!
eng: S-sorry about that. Sometimes\nI try a little TOO hard...
esp: Lo siento... pero me alegra que\nlo hayas pasado bien conmigo.
fra: Désolé. J'ai parfois du mal à\ncontrôler ma force...
ita: Ehm, mi spiace. A volte ci vado\nun po' pesante.
nld: S-Sorry. Soms ben ik iets TE\nfanatiek...
tur: Ö-özür dilerim. Bazen gücümü\nbiraz FAZLA kaçırıyorum...

label: Player_StgWin_264
deu: Ach, das Denken erledigen die\nwohl auch, ja? Dachte ich mir...
eng: Your muscles have a mind of\ntheir own, huh?
esp: Pues que te duren;\nraciónatelos día a día.
fra: Tes muscles sont des êtres à\npart entière ?
ita: I tuoi muscoli sono senzienti?!\nStarai scherzando, spero...
nld: Hebben je spieren een eigen\nleven?

label: Player_StgWin_265
deu: Na, jetzt haben wir halt ein\nbisschen intensiver trainiert...
eng: Did you even notice that we\nhad a sushi battle just now?
esp: ¿Tú crees que te enviaron aquí\npara que estuvieras tranquilo?
fra: Tu as remarqué qu'on venait\nde se battre, au moins ?
ita: Ti sei accorto della battaglia di\nsushi che abbiamo combattuto?
nld: Heb je bij het sushigevecht van\ndaarnet niet opgelet?
tur: Az önce suşi savaşı yaptığımızı\nfark ettin mi bari?

label: Player_StgWin_266
deu: Und ich dachte, SOLDATEN\nhätten mehr Pflichtgefühl...
eng: Uhh, how many "minutes" has\nit been now?
esp: Esto... ¿Cuántas veces\nha dicho eso ya?
fra: Tes supérieurs sont d'accord\navec cet ordre de priorités ?
ita: Qualche minuto, dici?\nQuanti per l'esattezza?
nld: Eh... Je hebt zeker heel wat\nkrachttraining in te halen?

label: Player_StgWin_267
deu: Viel Glück bei der Suche\nnach ihm!
eng: Hope you find your friend!
esp: "Esto" ya no tiene remedio, pero\n¡ojalá encuentres a tu amigo!
fra: J'espère que tu la trouveras !
ita: Spero che tu riesca a trovare\nil tuo amico!
nld: Hopelijk vind je je vriend!

label: Player_StgWin_268
deu: Auf dem Verliererbildschirm,\nso viel steht mal fest!
eng: Wake up! It's time to come to\nyour senses!
esp: Ya... Pues más te habría\nvalido trascender antes.
fra: Allez, on se réveille ! Il faut se\nressaisir, un peu !
ita: Ehi, Mister Deltoide...\nTorna in te!
nld: Wakker worden! Het is tijd om\nte stoppen met dromen!

label: Player_StgWin_269
deu: Imperiale, die mich aufhalten\nwollen. Die nerven!
eng: Where there's Imperials to bust,\nI'll be there doing the busting!
esp: La fuerza me viene del Imperio:\n¡de las ganas de combatiros!
fra: C'est simple ! Le désir de\nvaincre les troupes impériales !
ita: Dove ci sono imperiali da battere,\nci sono anch'io!
nld: Als er keizerlijke troepen moeten\nworden ingemaakt, sta ik vooraan!
tur: Nerede pataklanacak bir İmparatorluk\naskeri varsa, ben oradayım!

label: Player_StgWin_270
deu: Du dagegen bist nicht mehr als\nein weiterer blöder Erwachsener.
eng: Is it worse that you called me\n"unruly" or a "child"?!
esp: No sé si me molesta más lo de\n"crío" o lo de "caprichoso".
fra: Je sais pas si je suis plus vexé\npar « sale » ou par « gamin »...
ita: Non so se mi offende di più\n"ragazzino" o "dispettoso"...
nld: Ik weet niet wat ik irritanter\nvind, "opstandig" of "kind"...
tur: Bana 'yaramaz' demen mi daha kötü,\nyoksa 'çocuk' demen mi?!

label: Player_StgWin_271
deu: Weil ich auf Sushi setze,\nnicht auf Psycho-Quatsch!
eng: Because I focus on sushi,\nnot psychic mumbo jumbo!
esp: Es el poder del sushi frente\na la charlatanería paranormal.
fra: En me concentrant sur les\nsushis, c'est la base !
ita: Perché mi concentro sul sushi.\nNon sulle psico-stupidaggini!
nld: Omdat het mij om sushi gaat,\nniet om helderziende nonsens!
tur: Çünkü ben suşiye odaklanırım,\npsişik zırvalıklara değil!

label: Player_StgWin_272
deu: Ganz einfach: Ich liebe Sushi mehr\nals du. Deshalb habe ich gewonnen.
eng: It's easy—I love sushi more than\nyou, so I won!
esp: Es muy fácil: amo al sushi más\nque tú y por eso he ganado.
fra: Mon amour des sushis est plus\ngrand, donc j'ai gagné !
ita: È facile: amo il sushi più di te\nquindi ti ho battuto!
nld: Heel simpel: ik hou meer van sushi\ndan jij!
tur: Basit: Suşiyi senden çok seviyorum;\nbu yüzden kazandım!

label: Player_StgWin_273
deu: Stell dich nicht plötzlich\nso schwach und unschuldig!
eng: Seeing you act so fragile all of\na sudden is weird!
esp: Ahora te duele, pero darme\nplatazos no te importaba, ¿no?
fra: Pourquoi tu te mets à parler\ncomme une fillette tout à coup ?
ita: Oh, povera lei... La prossima volta\nci andrò più piano, d'accordo?
nld: Best raar om je ineens zo gekwetst\nte zien doen!

label: Player_StgWin_274
deu: Ich bin nur so stark, wie\nmein Sushi mich macht.
eng: I'm only as strong as sushi\nmakes me!
esp: ¡Es la fuerza que me da el sushi!\n(Pero sigo igual de canijo.)
fra: Ce sont les sushis qui me\nrendent plus fort !
ita: La mia forza viene dal sushi,\nquindi tutto è possibile!
nld: Ik ben enkel zo sterk als de sushi\ndie ik eet!

label: Player_StgWin_275
deu: Ich hab halt gegen viele\nstarke Gegner gekämpft!
eng: I've fought so many tough\nenemies that I can't help it!
esp: ¡He vencido a tantos enemigos\nque ya no puedo evitarlo!
fra: C'est parce que j'ai combattu\ndes tas d'ennemis !
ita: È l'esperienza! Ho combattuto\nun sacco di avversari!
nld: Ik heb zoveel sterke tegenstanders\nverslagen dat het vanzelf ging!
tur: Bunca güçlü rakiple kapışınca\ninsan ister istemez güçleniyor!

label: Player_StgWin_276
deu: Puh... Du nimmst diesen Kram\naber ganz schön ernst, was?
eng: Wow, you take this stuff pretty\nseriously, huh?
esp: Revisa, revisa. Puede que sea\nfalta de respeto por el sushi...
fra: Eh ben, tu prends ça très\nau sérieux, dis-moi...
ita: Prendi queste battaglie molto\nsul serio, a quanto vedo.
nld: Wauw, je neemt het wel serieus, hè?
tur: Vay, bu işi bayağı\nciddiye alıyorsun ha?

label: Player_StgWin_277
deu: Na, Teller werfen ohne Ende!\nBringt halt mehr als Hanteln stemmen!
eng: I've grown a lot as a sushi\nstriker! But you knew that, huh?
esp: Ya... Pues eso te pasa por\njuzgar según las apariencias.
fra: J'ai beaucoup grandi en tant\nque sushiste, tu sais...
ita: Sappi che ho temprato il mio cuore\nin molte battaglie di sushi.
nld: Als sushistriker ben ik ver gekomen!\nMaar dat wist je zeker al?
tur: Suşi vuruculuğunda çok ilerledim!\nAma sen zaten biliyordun, değil mi?

label: Player_StgWin_278
deu: Hey! Ich nenne dich nicht Oma,\nalso nenn mich nicht Baby!
eng: Hey! If I don't get to call you\nold, you can't call me a child!
esp: ¡Y dale con lo de "crío"!\n¿Os llamo yo viejos a vosotros?
fra: Je vous traite pas de vieille,\nalors me traitez pas d'enfant !
ita: Ma la smetti una buona volta\ndi darmi della pulce?!
nld: Hé! Als ik jou niet oud noem,\nnoem mij dan ook geen baby!
tur: Hey! Ben sana yaşlı diyemiyorsam,\nsen de bana çocuk diyemezsin!

label: Player_StgWin_279
deu: Hatte ich ganz sicher nicht vor.\nHast du sie noch alle...?
eng: I already didn't want to,\nand now I'm scared to!
esp: Tranquilo, que es lo último\nque haría... ¡Qué horror!
fra: Déjà que je voulais pas,\nmaintenant j'en ai peur !
ita: Non ci ho mai pensato. E spero\ndi non doverlo fare mai!
nld: Dat zou al niet in me opkomen, maar\nnu zou ik het helemaal niet durven!

label: Player_StgWin_280
deu: Und genau deshalb will ich\ndiesen Krieg beenden!
eng: You're right. That's why I'm\ntrying to end this war!
esp: Tienes razón, ¡y por eso intento\nponerle fin!
fra: Tu as raison. C'est pourquoi\nje veux mettre fin à celle-ci !
ita: Giusto... ma voglio vincere per essere\ncerto che la guerra finisca!
nld: Je hebt gelijk. Daarom probeer ik deze\noorlog tot een einde te brengen!
tur: Haklısın. Bu yüzden bu\nsavaşı bitirmeye çalışıyorum!

label: Player_StgWin_281
deu: Wir könnten noch mal kämpfen,\ndann kriegst du wieder neues.
eng: I'm always happy to fight, if it\nhelps you eat!
esp: Si ha servido para eso,\n¡más me alegra esta victoria!
fra: Si ça peut te faire manger, je\nt'affronterai quand tu voudras.
ita: Questa tua frase rende la mia\nvittoria ancora più gloriosa!
nld: Als je nog trek in sushi hebt, kunnen\nwe nog wel een ronde vechten!

label: Player_StgWin_282
deu: Der Schwachpunkt ist deine\nallgemeine Einstellung!
eng: If there was a weak link, it was\nyour whole general attitude...
esp: No, los músculos no.\nEs tu actitud en general.
fra: C'est plutôt à cause de\nton attitude, je dirais...
ita: È stata la tua volontà a cedere,\nbello mio...
nld: Wat je zwakke plek is?\nJe hele instelling is zwak...
tur: Bir zayıf halka vardıysa\no da tüm o genel tavrındı...

label: Player_StgWin_283
deu: Danke für das Kompliment!\nSag doch einfach „Musashi“!
eng: Thanks for the compliment, but\ndid you really forget my name?!
esp: Gracias por lo de "famoso",\npero no es lo más importante.
fra: Merci, mais vous aviez vraiment\noublié mon nom ?
ita: Grazie per il "famoso", ma preferisco\nrimanere con i piedi per terra.
nld: Bedankt voor het compliment, en\nvoor het... kennen van mijn naam?!
tur: İltifat için sağ ol ama\nadımı gerçekten unuttun mu?!

label: Player_StgWin_284
deu: Dass ich kein kleines Kind bin, hat\nnichts mit WASABI zu tun!
eng: Mature? Me? Hey, yeah!\nI AM mature!
esp: ¿Que estoy madurando?\n¡Ya he madurado!
fra: Mature ? Moi ? Youhou !\nJe suis mature !
ita: "Verso la maturità"?!\nMa che ti inventi?
nld: Volwassen? Ik? Eh, natuurlijk!\nIk BEN volwassen!
tur: Olgun mu? Ben mi? Hey, evet!\nBEN olgunum!

label: Player_StgWin_285
deu: Heißt das, dass ich noch besser\nals er werden kann?
eng: If he was this good then, will I\never be better than him?
esp: ¿Eso significa que puedo llegar\na ser aún mejor que él?
fra: Comment je peux le surpasser\ns'il était déjà si fort ?
ita: Se era così abile, chissà se riuscirò\nmai a essere più bravo di lui...
nld: Als hij toen zo goed was, kan\nik dan nog beter worden?
tur: O zaman bile bu kadar iyiyse,\nben onu hiç geçebilecek miyim?

label: Player_StgWin_286
deu: Hör mal, das sind ja wohl keine\nechten Neuigkeiten mehr.
eng: I've taken apart enough of you\nto know how it works by now!
esp: A estas alturas ya no debería\nsorprenderle a nadie.
fra: À force de vous tailler en\npièces, j'ai l'habitude !
ita: A questo punto non dovresti\npiù sorprenderti di nulla.
nld: Ik heb er al genoeg van jullie verslagen\nom de slag te pakken te krijgen!
tur: Seni yeterince parçaladım;\nartık nasıl çalıştığını biliyorum!

label: Player_StgWin_287
deu: Jep. Und auch sonst bist du\nmir ja irgendwie ähnlich...
eng: Is your name also Musashi?\nYou remind me of someone...
esp: ¡No, soy yo, no tú!\nOye, me recuerdas a alguien...
fra: Toi aussi, tu t'appelles Musashi ?\nTu me rappelles quelqu'un...
ita: Pure tu ti chiami Musashi?\nSai, mi ricordi qualcuno...
nld: Heet jij ook Musashi? Je doet me aan\niemand denken...
tur: Adın senin de Musashi mi?\nBirini hatırlatıyorsun...

label: Player_StgWin_288
deu: Kommt mir auch so vor, aber ich\nkann mir auch nicht alles merken!
eng: Umm... I don't know, did you?\nI don't remember either.
esp: Pues... no sé, yo tampoco\nestoy seguro.
fra: Euh... Je sais pas. Peut-être.\nJe me souviens pas non plus.
ita: Uhm... Veramente non saprei. Dici?\nNon mi ricordo neanch'io.
nld: Umm... Weet ik niet, is dat zo?\nIk kan het me niet herinneren.
tur: Şey... bilmiyorum, kapıştık mı?\nBen de hatırlamıyorum.

label: Player_StgWin_289
deu: Der Befreiungsfront ist mit mir\nklar besser gedient als mit dir.
eng: The SLF is better off in my\nhands anyway!
esp: ¡Ni falta que hace! El FLS\nestá mejor en mis manos.
fra: Je suis bien plus compétent\npour diriger le FLS !
ita: Il FLS è in una botte di ferro\ncon me!
nld: Het SVL is in mijn handen\nbeter af!
tur: Zaten SLF benim elimde daha\niyi olur!

label: Player_StgWin_290
deu: Sushi essen, Sushi essen und...\nSushi essen!
eng: Well, first I eat sushi, and then\nI eat some more!
esp: Sí, es muy fácil: primero, comes\nsushi... y repites hasta cansarte.
fra: D'abord, je mange un peu de\nsushi, et puis encore un peu...
ita: Beh, se per allenarsi intendi\nmangiare sushi... Sì, un bel po'.
nld: Eerst eet ik sushi, en dan eet ik\nnog meer sushi!
tur: Önce suşi yerim, sonra da\nbiraz daha yerim!

label: Player_StgWin_291
deu: Ach, wenn du Glück hast gibt's\nnur Ärgerchen!
eng: Why do I think you're going to\ntell her as soon as you can...
esp: Para ser tan maravillosa, parece\nun poco tirana.
fra: Et laisse-moi deviner, tu vas\nt'empresser d'aller lui dire...
ita: Scommetto che non vedi l'ora\ndi informarla, eh?
nld: Waarom heb ik het gevoel dat je het haar\nzo snel mogelijk gaat vertellen?
tur: Nedense bunu ilk fırsatta\nona yetiştireceksin gibi geliyor...

label: Player_StgWin_292
deu: Darum geht's beim Sushi-Kampf.\nLern mal die Regeln!
eng: That's what sushi striking is\nabout! Get with the program!
esp: ¡No hay truco! ¡Es el oficio\ndel lanzaplatos!
fra: Pas juste ? C'est le principe\nmême des combats de sushis !
ita: È così che si lotta con il sushi!\nImpara per bene le regole!
nld: Daar gaat het om bij sushigevechten!\nBij de les blijven!

label: Player_StgWin_293
deu: Bei dir hätte ich mir auch\nnichts anderes erlauben dürfen!
eng: I can't afford to hesitate! Not\nwhen it comes to you!
esp: ¡Contigo no puedo\npermitirme dudas!
fra: Je ne peux pas me permettre la\nmoindre hésitation face à toi !
ita: Non posso permettermi di esitare,\nin particolar modo con te!
nld: Ik mag niet weifelen! Niet\nmet jou in de buurt!

label: Player_StgWin_294
deu: Wär mir recht gewesen. Ich wüsste\ngern, was darunter steckt...
eng: What's under there, anyway?\nCan I get a quick peek?
esp: Ay, qué lástima... ¡Con la\ncuriosidad que me despierta!
fra: Et qu'est-ce qu'il y a en\ndessous ? Allez, montre-moi !
ita: Mi chiedo cosa ci sia sotto. Non è\nche mi faresti dare un'occhiatina?
nld: Wat zit daaronder?\nMag ik eens kijken?
tur: Orada ne var öyle?\nBir bakıp çıkabilir miyim?

label: Player_StgWin_295
deu: Merk dir endlich: Es ist nicht das\nWasabi, das zum Erfolg führt.
eng: You're as big a brat as me,\nand you have no excuse!
esp: Claro, y ahora dirás que\nte he ganado por eso, ¿no?
fra: Non mais oh ! Morveux\ntoi-même !
ita: Ah sì? È tu cosa saresti, scusa?\nUna grande peste?
nld: Je bent net zo'n snotneus als\nik, dus je hebt geen excuus!
tur: Benim kadar şımarıksın,\nhem de bahanen yok!

label: Player_StgWin_296
deu: Du bist ja auch ein würdiger\nGegner, da wird's hitzig!
eng: Thanks! I have to be when I\nfight someone as good as you!
esp: ¡Gracias! Si lucho con alguien\ncomo tú, tengo que superarme.
fra: Il faut l'être quand on affronte\nquelqu'un comme toi !
ita: Grazie! Non potevo certo distrarmi\ncon un abile avversario come te!
nld: Bedankt! Dat moet ook wel als ik\ntegen iemand vecht die zo goed is!
tur: Sağ ol! Senin gibi biriyle\nkapışınca formda olmak şart!

label: Player_StgWin_297
deu: Du hast offensichtlich die\nfalschen Stellen trainiert...
eng: I think you've been training the\nwrong things...
esp: Es que los estás sobrecargando.\nTienes que entrenar otras cosas.
fra: Je crois que tu n'as pas\nentraîné ce qu'il fallait.
ita: Forse dovresti allenare un po'\ndi più il cervello? Che ne dici?
nld: Ik denk dat je de verkeerde dingen\nhebt getraind...

label: Player_StgWin_298
deu: Ich esse ja immer alles auf,\nalso stell dich nicht so an!
eng: There's nothing wrong with tuna\nor salmon! Don't be stubborn!
esp: ¡El salmón y el atún no tienen\nnada de malo! ¡Es una manía tuya!
fra: Arrête ton cirque ! Il n'y a rien\nde mal à manger du saumon !
ita: Non c'è niente di male nel tonno e\nnel salmone. È solo una tua mania!
nld: Er is niets mis met tonijn of\nzalm! Wees niet zo koppig!
tur: Ton balığıyla somonda hiçbir sorun yok!\nİnat etme!

label: Player_StgWin_299
deu: Ich lass mich von Sushi leiten.\nUnd da redet mir auch keiner rein!
eng: I just follow my own path and\nlet sushi be my guide!
esp: No es ningún secreto:\n¡seguir el camino del sushi!
fra: Je me laisse guider par les\nsushis, c'est tout !
ita: Io? Seguo solo la mia strada,\nfacendomi guidare dal sushi!
nld: Ik volg mijn eigen pad en laat me\ndoor de sushi leiden!
tur: Kendi yolumda giderim;\nyolumu da suşi gösterir!

label: Player_StgWin_300
deu: Scheinst ja nicht sehr überzeugt\nvon dir selbst zu sein...
eng: Does that mean you're giving\nup? Seems kinda cowardly!
esp: ¿Entonces ni lo vas a intentar?\nVaya cobardica.
fra: Hein ? Tu abandonnes ?\nC'est pas très courageux.
ita: Vuol dire che tu ci rinunci?\nTi facevo più coraggioso.
nld: Betekent dat dat je het opgeeft?\nWat laf!
tur: Bu pes ettiğin anlamına mı geliyor?\nBiraz korkakça!

label: Player_StgWin_301
deu: Hast du gerade nicht genug Sushi\ngegessen? Du bist ja unersättlich!
eng: B-but we were both eating\nsushi the whole time!
esp: ¡Pero si tú ya te comes\nel sushi de tus platos!
fra: Mais on mangeait tous les\ndeux les sushis !
ita: M-Ma se non abbiamo fatto altro\nche mangiare sushi tutto il tempo?!
nld: M-Maar we aten allebei\nde hele tijd sushi!
tur: A-ama ikimiz de baştan sona\nsuşi yiyorduk!

label: Player_StgWin_302
deu: Ja, krass... Man kämpft nicht\njeden Tag gegen sich selbst!
eng: It's not every day you get to\nfight yourself!
esp: ¡Qué raro es esto de luchar\ncontra uno mismo!
fra: C'est pas tous les jours qu'on\nse bat contre soi-même !
ita: Non capita tutti i giorni di lottare\ncontro sé stessi! O no?
nld: Het gebeurt niet elke dag dat\nje tegen jezelf vecht!

label: Player_StgWin_001_f
eng: This is sushi striking, huh?\nI'm loving it already!
tur: Demek suşi vuruculuk bu, ha?\nŞimdiden bayıldım!

label: Player_StgWin_002_f
eng: Another victory, another belly\nfull of sushi!
tur: Bir zafer daha, bir karın dolusu\nsuşi daha!

label: Player_StgWin_003_f
eng: You're just mad because you\ndon't have one, Kojiro!

label: Player_StgWin_004_f
eng: I love sweets almost as much\nas I love sushi!

label: Player_StgWin_005_f
eng: I've had static cling worse than\nyour Electrozap!
tur: Senin Elektroşok'undan daha kötüsünü\nstatik elektrikten yaşadım!

label: Player_StgWin_006_f
eng: My sushi striking can bust\nthrough any shield!

label: Player_StgWin_007_f
eng: Wow! Talk about a fast-\npaced fight!

label: Player_StgWin_008_f
eng: NOW are you gonna stop\ntreating me like a kid?!
fra: Tu sais ce qu'elle te dit,\nla gamine ?
ita: Adesso la smetterai di trattarmi\ncome una poppante?
tur: ŞİMDİ bana çocuk muamelesi\nyapmayı bırakacak mısın?!

label: Player_StgWin_009_f
eng: You know your attacks are all\nreally obvious, right?
tur: Saldırıların hepsi\nçok belli, biliyorsun değil mi?

label: Player_StgWin_010_f
eng: Capsules sure are neat! Thanks\nfor letting me have so many!
tur: Kapsüller gerçekten harika! Bana\nbu kadarını verdiğin için sağ ol!

label: Player_StgWin_011_f
eng: You specialize so much that you\nforgot all the basics!
tur: O kadar uzmanlaştın ki\nen temel şeyleri unuttun!

label: Player_StgWin_012_f
eng: Yesss! Nothing's standing in\nmy way now!

label: Player_StgWin_013_f
eng: I'll never join the Empire!\nDon't bother asking again!
tur: Asla İmparatorluğa katılmam!\nBir daha sormaya kalkma!

label: Player_StgWin_014_f
eng: Put a shirt on already!

label: Player_StgWin_015_f
eng: I'm the better striker! Though I\ndo wish I had cool muscles...
tur: Daha iyi vurucu benim! Yine de\nkeşke havalı kaslarım olsaydı...

label: Player_StgWin_016_f
eng: What does working out have to\ndo with sushi striking?
tur: Spor yapmanın suşi\nvuruculuğuyla ne ilgisi var?

label: Player_StgWin_017_f
eng: Your rank and your build don't\nmatter if you're in my way!
tur: Vücudunun bu hâliyle\nnasıl bu kadar hızlısın?!

label: Player_StgWin_018_f
eng: Sorry about getting you fired!\nMaybe just leave the Empire?
tur: Seni kovdurduğum için kusura bakma!\nİmparatorluk'tan ayrılsana?

label: Player_StgWin_019_f
eng: Shuffle the sushi all you want—\nI'm going to eat it all anyway!
tur: Suşiyi istediğin kadar karıştır—\nben yine de hepsini yiyeceğim!

label: Player_StgWin_020_f
eng: That girl looked like she was\nmy age... That's so sad.
tur: O kız benimle yaşıt gibi...\nNe kadar üzücü.

label: Player_StgWin_021_f
eng: Just let me through! I need to\nsee that girl again!
tur: Bırak da geçeyim! O kızı\nyeniden görmem gerek!

label: Player_StgWin_022_f
eng: I won, so get lost! You're\nstanding in my way!

label: Player_StgWin_023_f
eng: Is this the way Celia went?

label: Player_StgWin_024_f
eng: Celia's gotta be up ahead\nsomewhere...

label: Player_StgWin_025_f
eng: I hope I'm starting to get\nthrough to Celia...

label: Player_StgWin_026_f
eng: Muscles don't deflate! Stop\ntalking nonsense and go away!

label: Player_StgWin_027_f
eng: "Perfectorals"? One of us has\na lot to learn about anatomy...

label: Player_StgWin_028_f
eng: Wow. Did I beat you so bad that\nyou burst into poetry?
tur: Vay... Seni o kadar mı fena yendim ki\nşiire döktün?

label: Player_StgWin_029_f
eng: I'll pass. I don't need muscles\nOR the Empire!
tur: Pas geçiyorum. Ne kaslara\nne de İmparatorluğa ihtiyacım var!

label: Player_StgWin_030_f
eng: I'm not stupid! Just listen to\nme for a minute!
fra: Pas le temps d'être rancunière !\nÉcoute-moi plutôt !
tur: Ben aptal değilim! Sadece\nbir dakika beni dinle!

label: Player_StgWin_031_f
eng: You'll never really appreciate\nsushi with that dumb skill!
tur: O aptal yetenekle suşinin\nkıymetini asla anlayamazsın!

label: Player_StgWin_032_f
eng: Are you catching a cold?\nDude, go get some bed rest!

label: Player_StgWin_033_f
eng: Then you should've used some\neye drops before the fight!

label: Player_StgWin_034_f
eng: Aw, that's no fun. You can't\nfight without enjoying the sushi!
tur: Ama böyle tadı çıkmaz! Suşinin\ntadını çıkarmadan savaşılır mı?

label: Player_StgWin_035_f
eng: How come everyone in this\nsquad looks ready to barf?!
fra: Je suis tombée sur le bataillon\ndes souffreteux, ou quoi ?
tur: Baş ağrın varsa biraz dinlen.\nKapışmayı sonra yaparız.

label: Player_StgWin_036_f
eng: I'm getting the hang of this\nstuff! Good soosh, buddy!
tur: Bu işin püf noktasını\nkapıyorum! İyi suş, dostum!

label: Player_StgWin_037_f
eng: Do you have a thing for the\nold guy or something?
tur: Yoksa o yaşlı adama mı\ntakıksın, ne?

label: Player_StgWin_038_f
eng: Yeah, right! Those are just big\nold crocodile tears!
tur: Hadi canım! Onlar sadece koca\nkoca timsah gözyaşları!

label: Player_StgWin_039_f
eng: No! Because then you'd\nhave won!

label: Player_StgWin_040_f
eng: Well... Would it help if I was\nright there with you?

label: Player_StgWin_041_f
eng: I just got out of the way.\nIt wasn't hard.

label: Player_StgWin_042_f
eng: Just because I can't eat wasabi\ndoesn't make me a little kid!
esp: Pues ni ser una niña ni pasar\ndel wasabi tienen nada de malo.
ita: Solo perché non mangio il wasabi non\nvuol dire che sono una poppante!
tur: Sırf wasabi yiyemiyorum diye\nbeni küçük çocuk sanma!

label: Player_StgWin_043_f
eng: It's sushi you're supposed to\nlove! Wasabi's just a condiment.
tur: Sevmen gereken suşi! Wasabi sadece\nbir çeşni.

label: Player_StgWin_044_f
eng: No, what YOU need is an\nintervention!
tur: Hayır, asıl SENİN bir\nmüdahaleye ihtiyacın var!

label: Player_StgWin_045_f
eng: I think all that wasabi has gone\nto your brain.

label: Player_StgWin_046_f
eng: You're not so bad yourself!

label: Player_StgWin_047_f
eng: Sorry about that, but I need to\nmove on ahead!

label: Player_StgWin_048_f
eng: If you want, I can come back\nlater and we can play instead!
tur: İstersen sonra tekrar gelirim\nve onun yerine oyun oynarız!

label: Player_StgWin_049_f
eng: Oh, is your back stiff? Do you\nwant me to try pounding it?
tur: Sırtın mı tutuldu? İstersen\nbir iki vurayım.

label: Player_StgWin_050_f
eng: I'm nice to everyone who's not\nan Imperial soldier!
tur: İmparatorluk askeri olmayan\nherkese karşı nazik olurum!

label: Player_StgWin_051_f
eng: I don't really see that\nhappening for you. Ever.

label: Player_StgWin_052_f
deu: Und Wasabi macht mich zur\nErwachsenen? Wieso denn?
eng: Is a taste for wasabi the secret\nto being an adult? Teach me!
tur: Wasabiyi sevmek yetişkinliğin\nsırrı mı? Bana öğret!

label: Player_StgWin_053_f
eng: Is that the guy who's supposed\nto be the best of the best?
tur: En iyilerin en iyisi denilen\nadam bu mu?

label: Player_StgWin_054_f
eng: Then try not being so picky!
tur: O zaman bu kadar seçici olma!

label: Player_StgWin_055_f
eng: Looks like they forgot to warn\nyou not to call me a little kid!
esp: ¡¿Y no te han dicho que\nno me llames "niña"?!
fra: Personne me traite de gamine !\nLes autres t'ont pas prévenu ?
ita: Hanno sicuramente dimenticato di\ndirti di non chiamarmi piccoletta!
tur: Galiba sana beni “küçük çocuk”\ndiye çağırmamanı söylememişler!

label: Player_StgWin_056_f
eng: Thanks for the warning,\nmister!

label: Player_StgWin_057_f
eng: What do you expect from a\nsuperstrong soosh striker?
esp: ¡Claro! ¡Por algo soy una\nsuperlanzaplatos de sushichús!
fra: Quoi de plus normal pour une\nsuper shisuste comme moi ?
ita: Che cosa ti aspettavi da una\nguerriera sushi forte come me?
tur: Süper güçlü bir suş vurucudan\nne bekliyordun?

label: Player_StgWin_058_f
eng: You and your squad had better\nget used to it!
tur: Sen ve timin buna alışsanız\niyi olur!

label: Player_StgWin_059_f
eng: Better to be a monkey than an\nImperial goon!

label: Player_StgWin_060_f
eng: You say that, but if you'd beat\nme, I bet you'd be the worst...
tur: Öyle diyorsun ama beni yensen,\nbence en beteri sen olurdun...

label: Player_StgWin_061_f
eng: Maybe now you'll admit you\nguys aren't all that great!
tur: Belki şimdi o kadar da harika\nolmadığınızı kabul edersiniz!

label: Player_StgWin_062_f
eng: There's a first time for\neverything!

label: Player_StgWin_063_f
eng: You thought wrong! I'm gonna\nclear a path right to Tiburon!
esp: Pues has creído mal. Y ahora\nvoy derechita a por Tiburón.
ita: Mi dispiace per te, ma arriverò\ndritta da Tiburon!

label: Player_StgWin_064_f
eng: Ohhh, so that's why everyone's\nstanding so close together!
tur: Ooo, demek herkesin bu kadar\ndip dibe durmasının sebebi bu!

label: Player_StgWin_065_f
eng: That's real sushi for you! You're\nsupposed to eat it with a smile!
tur: İşte gerçek suşi böyle olur!\nGülümseyerek yenir!

label: Player_StgWin_066_f
eng: What, that huge thing? I'm used\nto it by now!
ita: Ti riferisci a quell'arma enorme?\nMi ci sono già abituata!
tur: Ne, şu koca şey mi? Artık\nona alıştım!

label: Player_StgWin_067_f
eng: You can sulk later! Right now\nyou gotta let me through!

label: Player_StgWin_068_f
eng: "Almost"? How hard can it be\nto make toast?
tur: "Neredeyse" mi? Tost yapmak\nne kadar zor olabilir ki?

label: Player_StgWin_069_f
eng: Bad hips, trick knees, sore\nbacks... I've heard it all before!
tur: Kötü kalçalar, yamuk dizler, ağrıyan\nsırtlar... Hepsini daha önce duydum!

label: Player_StgWin_070_f
eng: If it helps, I could tell by the\nway you fought!

label: Player_StgWin_071_f
eng: I'll believe that when I see it!\nLet me through!

label: Player_StgWin_072_f
eng: Heck yeah you did! So uh, why\naren't you acting like you lost?
tur: Hem de nasıl yanıldın! Ee, peki\nniye kaybetmiş gibi davranmıyorsun?

label: Player_StgWin_073_f
eng: Your "methods" don't matter!\nSushi is more than a method!
tur: O “yöntemler”in önemi yok!\nSuşi bir yöntemden çok daha fazlası!

label: Player_StgWin_074_f
eng: You say that, but I'm going on\nahead anyway!
fra: Désolée, mais je m'apprête\njustement à continuer !

label: Player_StgWin_075_f
eng: You knew my name? Wow!\nAm I getting famous?!
esp: ¿Sabes mi nombre?\n¡Me estoy haciendo famosa!
ita: Conosci il mio nome? Wow!\nSto diventando famosa!
tur: Adımı biliyor muydun? Vay!\nÜnlü mü oluyorum?!

label: Player_StgWin_076_f
eng: "Finishing blow"? I'm not gonna\nhurt you! I'm the good guy!
ita: Ma quale colpo di grazia! Sono\nuna dei buoni, io.
tur: “Bitirici darbe” mi? Sana zarar\nvermeyeceğim! Ben iyi taraftayım!

label: Player_StgWin_077_f
eng: I'd taste sushi over defeat any\nday, that's for sure!

label: Player_StgWin_078_f
eng: Soosh? Sports? You make my\nhead hurt...

label: Player_StgWin_079_f
eng: Wait, is he happy he's going to\nget yelled at?!

label: Player_StgWin_080_f
eng: Wh-what a weirdo...

label: Player_StgWin_081_f
eng: Are that lady's troops OK?\nIn the head, I mean...
tur: O hanımefendinin askerleri iyi mi?\nYani... kafadan.

label: Player_StgWin_082_f
eng: This captain's even further gone\nthan his crew!
tur: Bu kaptan tayfasından bile daha\nbeter halde!

label: Player_StgWin_083_f
eng: Sure, it wasn't easy, but I\ncouldn't give up, right?
tur: Tabii kolay değildi ama\nvazgeçemezdim, değil mi?

label: Player_StgWin_084_f
eng: Sounds like that Purrsilla lady\nwon't let him have any...
tur: Anlaşılan Purrsilla hanım ona\nhiç suşi vermiyor...

label: Player_StgWin_085_f
eng: It's not just salmon! Some of\nit's tuna, too!
tur: Sadece somon değil! Bir kısmı\nton balığı da!

label: Player_StgWin_086_f
eng: Quit being stubborn and eat\nsome already!
tur: İnat etmeyi bırak da\nbiraz ye artık!

label: Player_StgWin_087_f
eng: Wow. You're so hungry for\nsalmon, you're hallucinating...
tur: Vay be. Somona o kadar\nacıkmışsın ki hayal görüyorsun...

label: Player_StgWin_088_f
eng: A mill? But we're eating rice,\nnot flour... I'm confused.
tur: Bin mi? Neye bineyim?\nŞeritlere mi? Kafam karıştı.

label: Player_StgWin_089_f
eng: So she's eating bonbons while\nyou're out here fighting?!
tur: Yani sen burada savaşırken\no bonbon mu yiyor?!

label: Player_StgWin_090_f
eng: Oh, is that why your mind never\nseemed to be on the fight?
tur: Demek aklın bu yüzden\nhiç dövüşte değildi?

label: Player_StgWin_091_f
eng: Ouch... Even her loyal soldiers\nare having a tough time.

label: Player_StgWin_092_f
eng: Help her? With what?

label: Player_StgWin_093_f
eng: My beef with you?! Listen, YOU\npicked a fight with ME!
ita: Cos'ho contro di te?! Senti, bello...\nsei TU che mi hai aggredita!
tur: Seninle derdim mi?! Bak, kavgayı\nsen başlattın, BEN değil!

label: Player_StgWin_094_f
eng: Good sushi wins out over any\nskill, no matter how tricky!
tur: Ne kadar zor olursa olsun,\niyi suşi her türlü yeteneği yener!

label: Player_StgWin_095_f
eng: Aaaaachoooo! Y-you might\nhave a point there...

label: Player_StgWin_096_f
eng: Y-y-you're being a good sport\nabout this. You deserve a rest!

label: Player_StgWin_097_f
eng: Between the two, I'd be more\nworried about your heater...
tur: İkisi arasında ben\nısıtıcın için daha çok endişelenirdim...

label: Player_StgWin_098_f
eng: Why do I feel even worse now?
tur: Neden şimdi daha da kötü hissediyorum?

label: Player_StgWin_099_f
eng: Wow, you're even mad about\nthe same thing as before!

label: Player_StgWin_100_f
eng: Oh, right! Still haven't put a\nshirt on, huh?
tur: Aa, doğru ya! Hâlâ\ntişört giymedin, ha?

label: Player_StgWin_101_f
eng: Sure! Can't really help it with all\nthe fighting I've been through!
tur: Tabii! Bunca savaştan sonra\nbaşka türlüsü olur mu?

label: Player_StgWin_102_f
eng: Someday you'll learn there's\nmore to life than exercise!
tur: Bir gün hayatın egzersizden\nibaret olmadığını anlayacaksın!

label: Player_StgWin_103_f
eng: Thanks! I think?
ita: Grazie! Sì, sono brava, ma non\nesageriamo.

label: Player_StgWin_104_f
eng: Hey, I call it like I see it!

label: Player_StgWin_105_f
eng: Get real! You don't get strong\nby making yourself suffer!

label: Player_StgWin_106_f
eng: The deflating muscles guy!\nDon't beat yourself up, man!

label: Player_StgWin_107_f
eng: The "perfectorals" guy too?!\nAre all of Kodiak's guys here?
tur: “Mükemmektoralis”çi de burada mı?!\nKodiak’ın bütün adamları mı geldi?

label: Player_StgWin_108_f
eng: I missed your poetry! Ever think\nof doing that full time instead?
tur: Şiirlerini özlemişim! Onu tam\nzamanlı yapmayı hiç düşündün mü?

label: Player_StgWin_109_f
eng: You know, it might actually be\nfun to have bulging muscles...
tur: Biliyor musun, kocaman kaslara\nsahip olmak aslında eğlenceli olabilir...

label: Player_StgWin_110_f
eng: Just let me free Franklin and I'll\nbe out of your hair!
tur: Franklin'i kurtarmama izin ver,\nsonra başından giderim!

label: Player_StgWin_111_f
eng: Give it a rest, Kodiak! That's no\nway to eat sushi!
tur: Bir dur artık, Kodiak! Suşi\nböyle yenmez!

label: Player_StgWin_112_f
eng: I-is that true? Well, don't let\nit get you down.
fra: Sans rire ? Et je suis censée\nprendre un air étonné ?

label: Player_StgWin_113_f
eng: Huh? But didn't the last guy\nalso say...
tur: Ha? Ama az önceki adam da\naynısını demedi mi...

label: Player_StgWin_114_f
eng: Can't you even come up with\nan original excuse?!

label: Player_StgWin_115_f
eng: Don't say you're the weakest\nin your squad! Don't even!

label: Player_StgWin_116_f
eng: Fighting you is almost starting\nto feel normal!

label: Player_StgWin_117_f
eng: So Sleeper is next... I look\nforward to tangling with him!
tur: Sıradaki Sleeper demek...\nOnunla kapışmayı dört gözle bekliyorum!

label: Player_StgWin_118_f
eng: So you're OK with dumping\nthe problem on Sawfish?
tur: Yani sorunu Sawfish'in üstüne\nyıkmana ses çıkarmıyorsun?

label: Player_StgWin_119_f
eng: This squad sure seems OK with\npassing the buck!
tur: Bu tim sorumluluğu birbirine\natmaya pek alışkınmış!

label: Player_StgWin_120_f
eng: It's rough to have all that\nresponsibility on your shoulders.

label: Player_StgWin_121_f
eng: Was that your secret weapon?\nSorry I had to go and break it!
fra: Désolée, je file. Bonne chance\navec votre canon pathétique !
tur: Gizli silahın bu muydu?\nKırmak zorunda kaldım, kusura bakma!

label: Player_StgWin_122_f
eng: I dunno. All that weight training\nseems like a lot of work...
tur: Bilmiyorum. O ağırlık çalışması\nçok zahmetli geliyor...

label: Player_StgWin_123_f
eng: Definitely not! I can't stand the\nway it stuffs up my nose!

label: Player_StgWin_124_f
eng: It wouldn't have helped. Just\neat whatever sushi you want!

label: Player_StgWin_125_f
eng: First you need to believe in\nsushi. Style will come later.

label: Player_StgWin_126_f
eng: Sushi style? You mean the way\nI eat sushi? That's kinda cool!
tur: Suşi tarzı mı? Yani suşi yeme\nşeklim mi? Bu bayağı havalı!

label: Player_StgWin_127_f
eng: You really love sushi... Dad\nhas good people under him.
tur: Suşiyi gerçekten seviyorsun...\nBabam iyi insanlarla çalışıyor demek.

label: Player_StgWin_128_f
eng: I dunno about everyone, but it's\ndefinitely true for me!
tur: Herkes için bilmem ama benim\niçin kesinlikle doğru!

label: Player_StgWin_129_f
eng: You're just another stepping\nstone on the way to my dad!
esp: ¡Eso es señal de que estoy\ndestinada a llegar a mi padre!

label: Player_StgWin_130_f
eng: Soldiers, cannons... Put 'em in\nmy way and I'll knock 'em out!

label: Player_StgWin_131_f
eng: I'm glad I got a chance to show\nyou my love for sushi!
fra: Je suis toujours heureuse de\npartager ma passion du sushi !
ita: E io sono lieta di averti potuto\nmostrare quanto amo il sushi!

label: Player_StgWin_132_f
eng: Wh-what's with the mask?\nYou're creeping me out...

label: Player_StgWin_133_f
eng: "Your end"? Don't make\nme laugh!

label: Player_StgWin_134_f
eng: Uhhh, are you broken? I'll...\nbe moving along now...
tur: Eee... bozuldu mu bu? Ben...\nyoluma bakayım...

label: Player_StgWin_135_f
eng: This is the least fun squad to\nbe around I've ever met!

label: Player_StgWin_136_f
eng: You're even here in the palace?\nJust what's your deal, huh?!
tur: Sarayda bile mi varsın?\nSenin derdin ne, ha?!

label: Player_StgWin_137_f
eng: Aww, get stuffed! My place is\nfighting here alongside my dad!
tur: Hadi oradan! Benim yerim\nburada, babamın yanında savaşmak!

label: Player_StgWin_138_f
eng: I'm just trying to show my dad\nhow far I've come!
ita: Voglio solo dimostrare a mio\npadre quanto sono cresciuta!

label: Player_StgWin_139_f
eng: That's what me and my dad are\nhere to stop!
tur: Babamla benim burada durdurmaya\nçalıştığımız şey de bu!

label: Player_StgWin_140_f
eng: So what you're saying is, we're\nalmost there? Let's go, Dad!

label: Player_StgWin_141_f
eng: I won't accept a world where\nyou guys control the sushi!
tur: Suşiyi sizin kontrol ettiğiniz bir\ndünyayı kabul etmiyorum!

label: Player_StgWin_142_f
eng: Sorry, I don't have time for your\nwhining! Gotta catch up to Dad!
tur: Üzgünüm, mızmızlanmanı dinleyecek\nvaktim yok! Babama yetişmeliyim!

label: Player_StgWin_143_f
eng: It's only endless for you! What\nabout the rest of the world?!
tur: Sadece senin için sonsuz! Peki ya\ndünyanın geri kalanı?!

label: Player_StgWin_144_f
eng: It's time I met Octavius. We\nneed to have a talk about sushi!

label: Player_StgWin_145_f
eng: Sushi doesn't belong to any\none person! It's everyone's!

label: Player_StgWin_146_f
eng: Because I picture everyone else\nin the world enjoying it, too!

label: Player_StgWin_197_f
eng: It's all mine! If you want one,\nfind it yourself!

label: Player_StgWin_198_f
eng: Dude... You lost, and you're\nstill making terrible puns?
tur: Dostum... Kaybettin ve hâlâ\nberbat kelime oyunları mı yapıyorsun?

label: Player_StgWin_199_f
eng: A shrine, huh? Is that where the\nlane-drive gear engineer is?
tur: Bir tapınak, ha? Şerit Dişlisi\nmühendisi orada mı?

label: Player_StgWin_200_f
eng: Heheh! No secret is safe with\nArchie around!
tur: Hehe! Archie yanındayken\nhiçbir sır güvende değil!

label: Player_StgWin_201_f
eng: Yeah! Why, are they supposed\nto be scary?
tur: Evet! Ne yani, korkutucu mu\nolmaları gerekiyor?

label: Player_StgWin_202_f
eng: You have fun! I'll just be on\nmy way...

label: Player_StgWin_203_f
eng: Don't believe everything\nyou hear!

label: Player_StgWin_204_f
eng: It's weird, but I feel like I've\nheard that before.

label: Player_StgWin_205_f
eng: You and everyone else in his\ncommand, apparently!
tur: Görünüşe göre sen de\nemrindeki herkes de!

label: Player_StgWin_206_f
eng: So that was their plan! Still,\nI'm getting that gear back!
tur: Demek planları buydu! Yine de,\no dişliyi geri alacağım!

label: Player_StgWin_209_f
eng: It doesn't matter! Sushi will\ncarry me past any obstacle!
tur: Önemi yok! Suşi beni her engelin\nötesine taşır!

label: Player_StgWin_210_f
eng: There's a suspicious experiment\nhere that I'll put a stop to!
tur: Burada şüpheli bir deney var;\nbuna son vereceğim!

label: Player_StgWin_211_f
eng: I sure am! I'm gonna get back\nwhat you stole!
ita: L'hai detto! Sono venuta a\nriprendermi ciò che avete rubato!

label: Player_StgWin_212_f
eng: It'll have to march on without\nthat gear, then!
tur: O zaman o dişli olmadan\nyoluna devam etmek zorunda!

label: Player_StgWin_213_f
eng: Don't believe that guy! Listen\nto your sushi-loving heart!
tur: O adama inanma! Suşi seven\nkalbini dinle!

label: Player_StgWin_214_f
eng: You don't have to prove you—\nWait, this sounds familiar.
tur: Kendini kanıtlamak zorunda değilsin—\nDur, bu tanıdık geldi.

label: Player_StgWin_215_f
eng: This guy sounds like the worst\nleader I've ever heard of!

label: Player_StgWin_216_f
eng: This whole squad has been\na real downer to fight...
fra: Ce bataillon me colle le cafard,\nje suis pas fâchée d'avoir fini.
tur: Bu timle kapışmak baştan sona\nmoral bozucuydu...

label: Player_StgWin_217_f
eng: Why is there a Magnetic Shot\nhere?! What are you guarding?!
tur: Burada neden Manyetik Atış var?!\nNeyi koruyorsun?!

label: Player_StgWin_218_f
eng: That's what you get for building\nmachines that waste sushi!
tur: Suşiyi boşa harcayan makineler\nyapmanın cezası bu!

label: Player_StgWin_219_f
eng: True happiness could never\ncome through a fake sushi gate!
tur: Sahte bir suşi kapısından\ngerçek mutluluk gelmez!

label: Player_StgWin_221_f
eng: Hey, I'm not the one who\nbrought it up!

label: Player_StgWin_222_f
eng: Hearing you say that just makes\nme more curious!

label: Player_StgWin_223_f
eng: I do feel bad about that. Maybe\ntell him I was just too good?
ita: Dai, senza rancore! Digli che la tua\navversaria era imbattibile, magari.
tur: Biraz kötü hissettim doğrusu. Ona\n“Musashi fazla iyiydi” dersin belki?

label: Player_StgWin_224_f
eng: Sun-o will be happier with\nme anyway!

label: Player_StgWin_225_f
eng: S-sorry about that. No hard\nfeelings, OK?
fra: Désolée. Allez, je file.\nSans rancune !

label: Player_StgWin_226_f
eng: I'd come with you, but I've got\na rare sushi sprite to find!
tur: Seninle gelirdim ama bulmam\ngereken nadir bir suşi ruhu var!

label: Player_StgWin_227_f
eng: Then that must mean there's\nsomething you were guarding!

label: Player_StgWin_228_f
eng: When my plates get stolen,\nI just eat more!
tur: Tabaklarım çalınırsa,\nben de daha çok yerim!

label: Player_StgWin_233_f
eng: I told you—Purrsilla isn't even\nhere anymore.

label: Player_StgWin_234_f
eng: Did nobody tell you Purrsilla\ndoesn't care about that now?
tur: Kimse sana Purrsilla'nın artık\nbunu umursamadığını söylemedi mi?

label: Player_StgWin_235_f
eng: He's so dedicated that it almost\nbrings a tear to my eye.
tur: O kadar adanmış ki neredeyse\ngözlerim doluyor.

label: Player_StgWin_236_f
eng: I didn't want to be the one to\nbreak it to you, but...
tur: Bunu sana söyleyen ben olmak\nistemezdim ama...

label: Player_StgWin_237_f
eng: They're not so hard when you\nknow how to handle 'em!
tur: Nasıl başa çıkacağını bilirsen\no kadar da zor değiller!

label: Player_StgWin_238_f
eng: Well, I am. Try not to be a sore\nloser about it!

label: Player_StgWin_239_f
eng: Nice try, but I think I see a\nshrine up ahead!
tur: İyi deneme, ama sanırım\nileride bir tapınak görüyorum!

label: Player_StgWin_240_f
eng: Guess it's true what they say:\nyou snooze, you lose!

label: Player_StgWin_249_f
eng: Hmmm... I don't see\nanything yet.

label: Player_StgWin_250_f
eng: It must've missed the\nwhole thing...

label: Player_StgWin_251_f
eng: Believe me, I could tell you\nwere fighting your heart out!

label: Player_StgWin_252_f
eng: You can trick me, but there's no\ngetting around my sushi skills!
ita: Puoi ingannarmi, ma nessuna frode può\nbattere il mio valore di guerriera sushi.

label: Player_StgWin_253_f
eng: What can I say? I hear the sushi\nsprite calling, that's all!
tur: Ne diyeyim? Suşi ruhunun\nsesini duyuyorum, hepsi bu!

label: Player_StgWin_254_f
eng: Just isn't your day, huh?

label: Player_StgWin_255_f
eng: A sixth sense is cool, but I like\nto say I have a nose for them!

label: Player_StgWin_256_f
eng: Eat some good sushi and you\nwon't even notice the cold!
tur: İyi bir suşi ye,\nsoğuğu fark etmezsin bile!

label: Player_StgWin_257_f
eng: It'll be easy! I'll just follow\nmy nose for sushi sprites!

label: Player_StgWin_258_f
eng: I will, thanks!

label: Player_StgWin_259_f
eng: Yeah, I could see how being\nout here will do that to you.

label: Player_StgWin_260_f
eng: This place is so pretty, I'd want\nto lose myself here too.
tur: Burası o kadar güzel ki,\nben de burada kaybolmak isterdim.

label: Player_StgWin_261_f
eng: Wait... This "stealth training"...\nAre you playing hide-and-seek?!

label: Player_StgWin_262_f
eng: I can't tell if he means with me\nor his hide-and-seek soldiers...
tur: Benimle mi yoksa saklambaç askerleriyle\nmi dediğini anlayamıyorum...

label: Player_StgWin_263_f
eng: S-sorry about that. Sometimes\nI try a little TOO hard...
fra: Désolée. J'ai parfois du mal à\ncontrôler ma force...
tur: Ö-özür dilerim. Bazen gücümü\nbiraz FAZLA kaçırıyorum...

label: Player_StgWin_264_f
eng: Your muscles have a mind of\ntheir own, huh?

label: Player_StgWin_265_f
eng: Did you even notice that we\nhad a sushi battle just now?
tur: Az önce suşi savaşı yaptığımızı\nfark ettin mi bari?

label: Player_StgWin_266_f
eng: Uhh, how many "minutes" has\nit been now?

label: Player_StgWin_267_f
eng: Hope you find your friend!

label: Player_StgWin_268_f
eng: Wake up! It's time to come to\nyour senses!

label: Player_StgWin_269_f
eng: Where there's Imperials to bust,\nI'll be there doing the busting!
tur: Nerede pataklanacak bir İmparatorluk\naskeri varsa, ben oradayım!

label: Player_StgWin_270_f
eng: Is it worse that you called me\n"unruly" or a "child"?!
esp: No sé si me molesta más lo de\n"cría" o lo de "caprichosa".
fra: Je sais pas si je suis plus vexée\npar « sale » ou par « gamine »...
ita: Non so se mi offende di più\n"ragazzina" o "dispettosa"...
tur: Bana 'yaramaz' demen mi daha kötü,\nyoksa 'çocuk' demen mi?!

label: Player_StgWin_271_f
eng: Because I focus on sushi,\nnot psychic mumbo jumbo!
tur: Çünkü ben suşiye odaklanırım,\npsişik zırvalıklara değil!

label: Player_StgWin_272_f
eng: It's easy—I love sushi more than\nyou, so I won!
tur: Basit: Suşiyi senden çok seviyorum;\nbu yüzden kazandım!

label: Player_StgWin_273_f
eng: Seeing you act so fragile all of\na sudden is weird!

label: Player_StgWin_274_f
eng: I'm only as strong as sushi\nmakes me!
esp: ¡Es la fuerza que me da el sushi!\n(Pero sigo igual de canija.)
fra: Ce sont les sushis qui me\nrendent plus forte !

label: Player_StgWin_275_f
eng: I've fought so many tough\nenemies that I can't help it!
tur: Bunca güçlü rakiple kapışınca\ninsan ister istemez güçleniyor!

label: Player_StgWin_276_f
eng: Wow, you take this stuff pretty\nseriously, huh?
tur: Vay, bu işi bayağı\nciddiye alıyorsun ha?

label: Player_StgWin_277_f
eng: I've grown a lot as a sushi\nstriker! But you knew that, huh?
tur: Suşi vuruculuğunda çok ilerledim!\nAma sen zaten biliyordun, değil mi?

label: Player_StgWin_278_f
eng: Hey! If I don't get to call you\nold, you can't call me a child!
esp: ¡Y dale con lo de "cría"!\n¿Os llamo yo viejos a vosotros?
tur: Hey! Ben sana yaşlı diyemiyorsam,\nsen de bana çocuk diyemezsin!

label: Player_StgWin_279_f
eng: I already didn't want to,\nand now I'm scared to!

label: Player_StgWin_280_f
eng: You're right. That's why I'm\ntrying to end this war!
ita: Giusto... ma voglio vincere per essere\ncerta che la guerra finisca!
tur: Haklısın. Bu yüzden bu\nsavaşı bitirmeye çalışıyorum!

label: Player_StgWin_281_f
eng: I'm always happy to fight, if it\nhelps you eat!

label: Player_StgWin_282_f
eng: If there was a weak link, it was\nyour whole general attitude...
tur: Bir zayıf halka vardıysa\no da tüm o genel tavrındı...

label: Player_StgWin_283_f
eng: Thanks for the compliment, but\ndid you really forget my name?!
esp: Gracias por lo de "famosa",\npero no es lo más importante.
ita: Grazie per il "famosa", ma preferisco\nrimanere con i piedi per terra.
tur: İltifat için sağ ol ama\nadımı gerçekten unuttun mu?!

label: Player_StgWin_284_f
eng: Mature? Me? Hey, yeah!\nI AM mature!
tur: Olgun mu? Ben mi? Hey, evet!\nBEN olgunum!

label: Player_StgWin_285_f
eng: If he was this good then, will I\never be better than him?
ita: Se era così abile, chissà se riuscirò\nmai a essere più brava di lui...
tur: O zaman bile bu kadar iyiyse,\nben onu hiç geçebilecek miyim?

label: Player_StgWin_286_f
eng: I've taken apart enough of you\nto know how it works by now!
tur: Seni yeterince parçaladım;\nartık nasıl çalıştığını biliyorum!

label: Player_StgWin_287_f
eng: Is your name also Musashi?\nYou remind me of someone...
tur: Adın senin de Musashi mi?\nBirini hatırlatıyorsun...

label: Player_StgWin_288_f
eng: Umm... I don't know, did you?\nI don't remember either.
esp: Pues... no sé, yo tampoco\nestoy segura.
tur: Şey... bilmiyorum, kapıştık mı?\nBen de hatırlamıyorum.

label: Player_StgWin_289_f
eng: The SLF is better off in my\nhands anyway!
fra: Je suis bien plus compétente\npour diriger le FLS !
tur: Zaten SLF benim elimde daha\niyi olur!

label: Player_StgWin_290_f
eng: Well, first I eat sushi, and then\nI eat some more!
tur: Önce suşi yerim, sonra da\nbiraz daha yerim!

label: Player_StgWin_291_f
eng: Why do I think you're going to\ntell her as soon as you can...
tur: Nedense bunu ilk fırsatta\nona yetiştireceksin gibi geliyor...

label: Player_StgWin_292_f
eng: That's what sushi striking is\nabout! Get with the program!

label: Player_StgWin_293_f
eng: I can't afford to hesitate! Not\nwhen it comes to you!

label: Player_StgWin_294_f
eng: What's under there, anyway?\nCan I get a quick peek?
tur: Orada ne var öyle?\nBir bakıp çıkabilir miyim?

label: Player_StgWin_295_f
eng: You're as big a brat as me,\nand you have no excuse!
tur: Benim kadar şımarıksın,\nhem de bahanen yok!

label: Player_StgWin_296_f
eng: Thanks! I have to be when I\nfight someone as good as you!
tur: Sağ ol! Senin gibi biriyle\nkapışınca formda olmak şart!

label: Player_StgWin_297_f
eng: I think you've been training the\nwrong things...

label: Player_StgWin_298_f
eng: There's nothing wrong with tuna\nor salmon! Don't be stubborn!
tur: Ton balığıyla somonda hiçbir sorun yok!\nİnat etme!

label: Player_StgWin_299_f
eng: I just follow my own path and\nlet sushi be my guide!
tur: Kendi yolumda giderim;\nyolumu da suşi gösterir!

label: Player_StgWin_300_f
eng: Does that mean you're giving\nup? Seems kinda cowardly!
tur: Bu pes ettiğin anlamına mı geliyor?\nBiraz korkakça!

label: Player_StgWin_301_f
eng: B-but we were both eating\nsushi the whole time!
tur: A-ama ikimiz de baştan sona\nsuşi yiyorduk!

label: Player_StgWin_302_f
eng: It's not every day you get to\nfight yourself!
esp: ¡Qué raro es esto de luchar\ncontra una misma!

label: Player_VsWin_Closely
deu: Das war knapp!\nWillst du eine Revanche?
eng: That was a close one! Let's\nhave a rematch, huh?
esp: ¡Por poco! ¿Te hace\nuna revancha?
fra: J'ai eu chaud ! Il faudra qu'on\nremette ça !
ita: Ho vinto di pochissimo!\nFacciamo un'altra partita?
nld: Dat scheelde niks! Zullen\nwe dat nog eens overdoen?

label: Player_VsWin
deu: So schlägt ein echter\nSushi Striker zu!
eng: Now that's how a sushi striker\ngets it done!
esp: ¡Así lucha un lanzaplatos!
fra: Et voilà comment un vrai\nsushiste remporte la victoire !
ita: Ecco come trionfa un vero\nguerriero sushi!
nld: Zo doet een sushistriker dat!
tur: İşte gerçek bir suşi vurucu\nböyle kazanır!

label: Player_VsLose_Closely
deu: Mann, voll knapp... Nächstes\nMal gewinne ich bestimmt!
eng: Awww! I was so close! I'll get\nyou next time for sure!
esp: ¡Aaay, por qué poquito! ¡La\npróxima seguro que te gano!
fra: Ah, j'y étais presque ! C'est moi\nqui gagnerai la prochaine fois !
ita: Accidenti! C'ero così vicino!\nMa la prossima volta vinco io!
nld: Aaah! Ik had bijna gewonnen!\nVolgende keer heb ik je!
tur: Ahh! Çok yaklaşmıştım! Bir dahaki\nsefere kesin seni yakalayacağım!

label: Player_VsLose
deu: Gut gemacht. Aber beim nächsten\nMal läuft's andersrum, wart's ab!
eng: You beat me fair and square.\nBut there's always next time!
esp: Has sido claramente superior.\n¡Pero ya veremos la próxima!
fra: Tu m'as battu à plate couture.\nJe ferai mieux la prochaine fois !
ita: Mi hai battuto nettamente.\nVedremo la prossima volta...
nld: Je hebt me eerlijk verslagen.\nVolgende keer beter!
tur: Beni bileğinin hakkıyla yendin.\nAma her zaman bir dahaki sefer var!

label: Player_VsWin_Closely_f
deu: Das war knapp!\nWie wär's mit 'ner Revanche?
eng: That was a close one! Let's\nhave a rematch, huh?

label: Player_VsWin_f
deu: So läuft das, wenn ein echter\nSushi Striker zuschlägt.
eng: Now that's how a sushi striker\ngets it done!
esp: ¡Así lucha una lanzaplatos!
fra: Et voilà comment une vraie\nsushiste remporte la victoire !
ita: Ecco come trionfa una vera\nguerriera sushi!
tur: İşte gerçek bir suşi vurucu\nböyle kazanır!

label: Player_VsLose_Closely_f
deu: Aaah! Ich war so nah dran!\nNächste Mal schlage ich dich!
eng: Awww! I was so close! I'll get\nyou next time for sure!
ita: Accidenti! C'ero così vicina!\nMa la prossima volta vinco io!
tur: Ahh! Çok yaklaşmıştım! Bir dahaki\nsefere kesin seni yakalayacağım!

label: Player_VsLose_f
deu: Du hast gut gekämpft! Beim\nnächsten Mal gewinne aber ich!
eng: You beat me fair and square.\nBut there's always next time!
fra: Tu m'as battue à plate couture.\nJe ferai mieux la prochaine fois !
ita: Mi hai battuta nettamente.\nVedremo la prossima volta...
tur: Beni bileğinin hakkıyla yendin.\nAma her zaman bir dahaki sefer var!

nld: WAT JAMMER. WIL JE HET\nOPNIEUW PROBEREN?

label: TxtPuzzleSettlementSerifEnemy01
deu: KNOBELN IST KOMPLEX.\nDIES WAR ERST DER ANFANG.
eng: PUZZLE MATCHES ARE DEEP.\nTHIS IS ONLY THE BEGINNING.
esp: TE QUEDA MUCHO\nQUE APRENDER.
fra: LES COMBATS CASSE-TÊTE\nSONT COMPLEXES.
ita: LE SFIDE ROMPICAPO NON SONO\nSEMPLICI. QUESTO È SOLO l'INIZIO.
nld: PUZZELGEVECHTEN ZIJN DIEPZINNIG.\nDIT IS NOG MAAR HET BEGIN.
tur: BULMACA MAÇLARININ İNCELİKLERİ ÇOK.\nBU DAHA BAŞLANGIÇ.

label: TxtPuzzleSettlementSerifEnemy02
deu: LANGSAM VERSTEHST DU\nMEINE KNOBELKÄMPFE.
eng: ARE YOU GETTING THE HANG\nOF MY PUZZLES?
esp: ¿YA LO PILLAS?
fra: EST-CE QUE TU T'HABITUES À\nMES CASSE-TÊTE ?
ita: STAI IMPARANDO A RISOLVERE\nI MIEI ENIGMI?
nld: KRIJG JE MIJN PUZZELS AL\nONDER DE KNIE?

label: TxtPuzzleSettlementSerifEnemy03
deu: SEHR GUT. NUN VERSUCHE,\nDICH ZU VERBESSERN.
eng: GOOD JOB. NOW TRY FOR\nA HIGHER SCORE!
esp: BIEN. ¡AHORA\nA POR MÁS PUNTOS!
fra: BIEN JOUÉ. ESSAIE DE FAIRE\nENCORE MIEUX !
ita: BEN FATTO, ORA PROVA A OTTENERE\nUN PUNTEGGIO PIÙ ALTO!
nld: GOED ZO. GA NU VOOR NOG\nMEER PUNTEN!

label: TxtPuzzleSettlementSerifEnemy04
deu: WUNDERBAR. DOCH DAS\nKANNST DU NOCH BESSER!

ita: OTTIMO, MA CREDO CHE TU\nPOSSA FARE DI MEGLIO!

ita: IMPARI IN FRETTA: HAI UN\nTALENTO PER I ROMPICAPI!
nld: JE LEERT VLUG. JE HEBT\nTALENT VOOR PUZZELEN!

eng: YOUR JUDGMENT IS WELL\nABOVE AVERAGE.
esp: TU INGENIO ESTÁ POR\nENCIMA DE LA MEDIA.
fra: TON ESPRIT DE DÉDUCTION\nSURPASSE LA MOYENNE.
ita: IL TUO ACUME È AL DI SOPRA\nDELLA MEDIA.
nld: JE INZICHT IS BOVENGEMIDDELD.

fra: TU AS PLUS DE MATIÈRE\nGRISE QUE MON CRÉATEUR.
ita: SEI PIÙ INTELLIGENTE ANCHE\nDEL MIO CREATORE.
nld: JE BENT NOG SLIMMER DAN\nMIJN MAKER.

ita: POCHISSIMI UMANI RISOLVONO\nI ROMPICAPI BENE COME TE.
nld: ER ZIJN WEINIG MENSEN DIE ZO\nGOED IN PUZZELS ZIJN ALS JIJ.

ita: HAI SUPERATO ANCHE ME.\nSEI UN ROBOT PER ENIGMI?

ita: Argh... Mi confondo sempre e\nmi faccio prendere dal panico...
nld: Arg... Ik krijg altijd de zenuwen\nen dan raak ik de kluts kwijt...

label: TxtPuzzleSettlementSerifPlayer01
deu: Hmm... ganz schön kompliziert.\nIch sollte besser überlegen...
eng: Hmm...this is tough. I should\nfigure out the trick to it.

fra: Hmm... C'est pas évident. Il faut\nque je chope le truc.
ita: Mmmh... È roba bella tosta questa.\nDevo capire il trucco che c'è dietro.

eng: I think I got it! OK, lemme\ngive it another shot!

fra: Je crois que ça vient ! Je vais\nessayer encore une fois !
ita: Credo di aver capito! OK, fammi\nprovare un'altra volta!
nld: Ik geloof dat ik het snap! Laat\nme het nog eens proberen!

deu: Jetzt verstehe ich das Prinzip.\nAber das geht noch besser!
eng: I feel like I'm getting it. I bet\nI can do even better next time!

ita: Credo di aver capito. Sono sicuro che\nfarò anche meglio la prossima volta.
nld: Ik begin het door te krijgen. Volgende\nkeer gaat het vast nog beter!

label: TxtPuzzleSettlementSerifPlayer04
deu: Danke! Moment... wird es\netwa NOCH schwieriger?

ita: Grazie! Ma... ora diventa più\ndifficile?
nld: Bedankt! Wacht eens, wordt het\nmoeilijker?
tur: Sağ ol! Dur, daha da mı zorlaşıyor?

label: TxtPuzzleSettlementSerifPlayer05
deu: Beim Knobelkampf zu gewinnen\nmacht echt Laune!
eng: You can't beat the feeling of\nsolving a good puzzle!

fra: Rien ne vaut la satisfaction de\nrésoudre un casse-tête !
ita: Non c'è niente di più piacevole\nche risolvere un bel rompicapo!
nld: Er gaat niets boven het oplossen\nvan een goede puzzel!
tur: İyi bir bulmacayı çözmenin\nkeyfi gibisi yok!

ita: Eh! Il mio fiuto per il sushi mi è utile\nanche con le sfide rompicapo!
nld: Ha! Mijn neus voor sushi werkt\nzelfs bij puzzelgevechten!
tur: Heh! Suşi burnum Bulmaca Maçlarında\nbile çalışıyor!

ita: Devi avere testa per fare il guerriero\nsushi! E non ho ancora finito!

tur: Suşi vurucu olmak için\nbeyin de lazım! Daha bitmedi!

ita: E pochissimi umani mangiano\nil sushi come me!
nld: Er zijn ook maar weinig anderen die\nzoveel sushi kunnen wegwerken!
